transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?
I keep planning my days around not having to drive over high bridges. And if I can’t avoid one, I just white-knuckle it the whole way across.
Do you experience similar fear or avoidance in any other situations, such as in crowds, on public transit, or in open spaces?
I haven’t really noticed it in other situations. It’s mainly the high bridges that get to me.
How long have you been dealing with this fear of high bridges?
About two years now. It started after I moved out during my separation and had to do a lot more driving around the county.
